learning_objective: 🎯 You will master the powerhouse of every sentence: the Verb! Learn how action words and helping words team up to make complete sense.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Verbs are the engine of a sentence! Action verbs tell us what the subject is physically or mentally doing. Words like 'jump', 'think', 'read', and 'sing' are all action verbs.

Sometimes, an action verb needs a friend to make the sentence's time or meaning clear. Helping verbs (like is, am, are, was, were) come right before the main verb to support it, like 'She IS reading'.

Auxiliary is just a fancy grammar word for Helping! These verbs not only help form tenses but also express things like possibility or permission. Words like 'can', 'may', 'must', and 'will' are special auxiliaries called Modals.

fun_activity.title: ✍️ The Verb Charades Game
fun_activity.instructions: Act out 3 action verbs silently for your family or friends, and see if they can guess the correct verb you are performing!

quick_recap: ⭐ A verb is a word used to describe an action, state, or occurrence.
⭐ Action verbs show what the subject is doing.
⭐ Helping (or Auxiliary) verbs support the main verb to clarify time or possibility.
